name: Bowl
overview: Scripture describes bowls as sacred vessels primarily made of gold or silver, used in the tabernacle and temple worship. These bowls, often accompanied by dishes, spoons, and covers, were crafted with great care and sometimes stamped with the inscription "Holiness to the Lord," signifying their consecrated purpose. The silver bowls, weighing specifically seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, were used in offerings of fine flour mingled with oil, highlighting their role in the sacrificial system. Through these details, the bowls symbolize the holiness and reverence required in approaching God’s presence.
